fact: Alleged failure to follow the Race Director's Event Notes regarding the escape road instructions at turn 14.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code and noncompliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 15, document 4).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 81 did not follow the Race Director's instructions concerning turn 14, but the Stewards determine that he left the track at the apex of turn 13 because his entry into the turn 13/14 section was significantly impacted by Car 63 and therefore he did not have sufficient time to react. Given the fact that he rejoined in a safe manner, no further action is warranted.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 81 Alleged Failure To Follow Race Directors Instructions
to: The Team Manager, McLaren Formula 1 Team
